scenes.name: reading
scenes.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic editorial interior photograph, landscape aspect ratio exactly 4:3 (ideally 1536 × 1152). This is image 1 of a coherent five-photo series showing a generative artwork in real homes. INPUTS: the five recent reference images are actual artworks in chronological order. Use ONLY reference image 1 as the artwork inside the one portrait frame. Reproduce its geometric composition, colors, paper ground and relative placement faithfully, not a redesigned approximation. Scene: A young adult quietly reading a book in a compact sunlit urban apartment, linen armchair, small oak side table, soft plaster wall. A modest 30 × 40 cm thin natural-oak portrait frame hangs above the side table. Intimate and lived-in, warm morning light. Composition: wide enough to establish home and activity, frame takes 20–35 percent of image height, artwork legible. Camera nearly frontal to the hanging frame so its portrait proportions remain clear; believable glass and frame shadows, restrained reflection. Natural tactile interiors, architectural editorial photography, subtle film grain, realistic hands and everyday clothing. The image contains one main wall artwork, no other competing art, no typography, no captions, no watermark, no UI. Do not create a collage. Every pixel outside the framed artwork should be a new realistic interior scene. Preserve the supplied image INSIDE the frame.
